subject: Follow-up: Procurement & Security for Redwood Inference - Acme
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Procurement & Security for Redwood Inference - Acme

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move toward procurement readiness on your side: 

Summary:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood for product search reranking and chat assistants (pilot scope confirmed).
- Pricing ballpark discussed; commercial path depends on whether you use PO / invoice or credit card + marketplace options.

Open items / asks for your procurement team:
1) Preferred commercial path: PO/invoice (net-30/45) vs. charge card vs. cloud marketplace (AWS Marketplace). If PO, any minimum contract value or approval thresholds we should know about?
2) Security gating: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II and a completed vendor security questionnaire. We'll attach our SOC 2 summary and a draft DPA for review. If you have a questionnaire link, send it over and we’ll complete it ASAP.
3) Timeline: target kickoff for pilot (if procurement clears) — what is your procurement lead time for new vendors?

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf, Redwood-DPA-draft.pdf, Redwood-MAP-template.docx

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll share the MAP and formal invoice/contract options this week.
- If helpful, we can schedule a short call with our security lead (Neha) to walk through SOC 2 scoping and the questionnaire.

Would you be able to confirm procurement path and share the vendor questionnaire link?

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Procurement & Security for Redwood Inference - Acme

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — helpful. A few quick answers from procurement: 

- Commercial path: For pilots under $50k we can usually proceed on corporate card. Anything above that goes through PO/invoice (Net 30). There is an internal threshold that requires Finance approval for commitments >$75k.
- Procurement lead time: for new vendors, expect 3–4 weeks to get PO + initial SOW signed once legal has reviewed contract.
- Security: we require SOC 2 Type II and a completed vendor questionnaire. Here’s the vendor questionnaire link: https://secureforms.acme.com/vendor-questionnaire/12345. Please return it to procurement@acme.com.

I’ve attached our standard procurement form (Acme-Procurement-Form.pdf) for you to prefill.

If you can confirm whether you’ll pursue marketplace vs. direct invoice, that helps us accelerate internal approvals.

Best,
Samantha
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Samantha.Lee@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Procurement & Security for Redwood Inference - Acme

Hi Samantha —

Great, thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and actions from our side: 

1) Marketplace vs. direct invoice: We can support both. For speed, corporate card or AWS Marketplace would be fastest for a pilot. If you prefer PO/invoice (Net 30), we’ll route through our billing team — Dev (cc’d) is the internal billing contact and can provide invoice templates and payment terms.

2) Security & questionnaire: Attached are the SOC 2 summary and our draft DPA (Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf; Redwood-DPA-draft.pdf). Neha (cc’d) is our Security & Privacy lead — she can coordinate completion of your vendor questionnaire and jump on a call if needed. We’ll also fill in the Acme procurement form and return to procurement@acme.com by EOD tomorrow.

3) Timeline: assuming questionnaire and procurement form are returned this week, and legal review takes ~1 week, we should be able to get a PO issued within your 3–4 week window. If you opt for a marketplace purchase, that could shorten to ~1 week.

4) Next steps (agreed):
- I’ll return the filled procurement form to procurement@acme.com by tomorrow.
- Neha will start on the vendor questionnaire; we can set a 30-minute sync with your security team on Friday if that works.
- Dev will follow up with billing/invoice samples and our standard MAP.

Folks — can we confirm a Friday 9:00 AM PT sync for security?

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Procurement & Security for Redwood Inference - Acme

Marissa —

Friday 9:00 AM PT works for a short security sync. A couple of additional asks from my side to make procurement smoother:

- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports SSO (SAML/Okta) for admin access and what data residency options exist? We have a few teams that require US-only storage for PII.
- Please include a point of contact in billing so we can trigger vendor onboarding forms.

If you can send the completed questionnaire and procurement form before the sync, we’ll have legal and security on the call.

Thanks — looking forward to the sync.

Samantha
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
Samantha.Lee@acme.com
